purpose: This table is a cleaned reference lookup of the sixteen air carriers that flew out of New York City in 2013, mapping each two-letter carrier code to its full legal name, sourced from the nycflights13 Bureau of Transportation Statistics carrier list.
usage: Join on carrier to enrich flight-level fact tables with the carrier's full name; carrier is the stable grain key and every row is guaranteed non-null and unique.
limitations: This is a small, static 16-row lookup with no temporal dimension and no duplicate or null issues to resolve; all three Airbyte capture-metadata columns were dropped as they carried no business content, so downstream consumers needing ingestion lineage must look elsewhere.
